records.Name: Dugway Proving Ground
records.Summary__c: The Army's chemical and biological defense proving ground in Utah's Great Salt Lake Desert: nearly 800,000 acres of salt flats, desert and mountains under nearly 8,000 square miles of restricted airspace, with up to 100 kilometers of long-range fires range. Open to industry for drone, counter-drone, long-range fires and interceptor testing.
